title: AC1024 BLOCKLOOKUPACTION row-major expressions and column metadata

scope.profile: 41 rows by 7 columns; 287 row-major expression strings; then seven column records, each with three BitLong codes, flag 282, one text value, flag 281, and one text value; final flag 280.
scope.admission: AC1024 only. Other DWG versions retain their previous parser path pending version-specific source evidence.

authority.title: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §§20.1 and 20.4
authority.used_for: Confirmed the generic object data/handle framing and the separate R2007+ string stream. The searched class prescriptions do not specify BLOCKLOOKUPACTION field order.

authority.title: ACadSharp DwgObjectReader.Objects.cs
authority.used_for: Independent source-level layout comparison: readBlockLookupAction consumes rows*columns text values, then numcols column records and a final bit; readLookupActionColumn consumes three BitLongs, flag 282, text, flag 281, and text. The implementation was not executed against this sample.

authority.title: LibreDWG dwg2.spec
authority.used_for: Compared the independent generated field inventory. It models a LUT per rows*columns entry with three code/name connection pairs and flags 282/281; this disagrees with ACadSharp's per-column record cardinality and the observed AC1024 body budget. LibreDWG currently marks this class UNSTABLE.

observed_source.before_fix: The previous minimum-data preflight required 287*8=2296 bits for per-cell LUT metadata; the available body span was only 209 bits at the first expression. A diagnostic-only ACadSharp-layout walk consumed all fields.
observed_source.candidate_cursor_result: The row-major expression plus seven column records consumed data and string cursors exactly to 510 and 72858, respectively; the object handle stream remained separately bounded.

implementation.behavior: For AC1024, parse the row-major expression grid before column metadata, bound inline record admission by the number of columns, store three codes/two text values/two flags per column, and require exact data and string stream endpoints. Other versions retain the prior path.
implementation.test: dwg_read_AC1024_blocklookupaction_profile is registered only when the existing local sample is present; the sample is not added to the repository.

focused_profile.result: PASS; rows=41, columns=7, expressions=287, three codes and two text values per column

limits: The local sample is untracked and its producer provenance is unverified. It was used only as existing local evidence and was not copied or committed.
ACadSharp was reviewed at source level but not run; its CSUtilities git submodule is not initialized in the local checkout.

The ACadSharp and LibreDWG layouts conflict. The selected body decode is supported by ACadSharp's independent reader source and the exact AC1024 cursor fit, but the conflict prevents a broad semantic or cross-version claim.
LibreDWG class recognition, its unstable field inventory, cursor fit, and this parser test do not prove native Dynamic Block behavior or correct evaluation semantics.
No DXF writer/output support, native application result, producer qualification, or support claim is established. Other versions retain the previous decode path.
